item.title: Maryland Permanently Preserves 11 Additional Working Farms
item.description: In an ongoing commitment to preserving Maryland’s agricultural legacy, the Maryland Board of Public Works has approved 11 new easements through the Maryland Agricultural Preservation Foundation.

item.title: Longtime Favorite Still Earns High Praise
item.description: For more than 20 years, we’ve sung the praises of Main & Market (nee Main Ingredient) as the casual café perfect for pairing conversation with top-tier cuisine.

item.title: Main & Market! Shares Recipe for Salmon Pisana
item.description: The recipe features a salmon filet with Mediterranean ingredients over Sun-Dried Tomato and Basil Polenta triangles. Enjoy!

item.title: Is Your Child Water-Ready? Discover Why Parents Are Talking about Goldfish Swim School®
item.description: Goldfish offers engaging, effective swim lessons designed specifically for children ages 4 months to 12 years old.

item.title: 93.5 WRNR Annapolis, MD pumps up the volume with a new FM signal!!
item.description: Legendary rocker ‘WRNR’ (WYRE-A / W228ER), which returned to the FM airwaves last July at the 93.5 FM frequency, is pleased to announce their expansion with the addition of W228DI (93.5 FM) Silver Spring, MD.

item.title: Positivity & Procedures: Cosmetic Procedures Don’t Mean You Dislike Yourself
item.description: When it comes to self-image, perhaps two ideas can coexist. Can you love yourself the way you are, but you still want to change some parts of your appearance?

item.title: What's Up? This Weekend 2/25
item.description: From legendary rock and soulful symphonies to foodie favorites, furry fundraisers, and hands-on inspiration, this week’s lineup is packed with ways to get out and experience the best of the region.

item.title: Annapolis Community Grant Portal Now Open
item.description: The Office of Community Services has opened the application portal for the City of Annapolis FY 2027 Community Grant program.

item.title: Obsessions: Edible Favors
item.description: Don’t have a favor that gets left behind at the end of the night! These edible options will give guests something to snack on and remember the night later.

item.description: What’s the difference between all these types of sugar?
